full_prompt_en: A square cinematic horror illustration shows two figures facing each other at very close range inside a cloud of cold blue smoke. The left figure stands upright in a dark fedora and a red-and-deep-green striped sweater. Beneath the hat brim, a scarred, deeply furrowed face turns toward the other figure, with one eye catching a small pale glint. On the right, a second figure in a vivid red jacket and soft dark cap bends forward, presenting mostly its shoulder and side profile. One hand reaches across the narrow space and presses against the striped chest, making a tense contact point at the center of the frame. Their bodies occupy most of the composition, but the lower left and far right dissolve into mist. Behind them there is no identifiable room or landscape, only layered blue-black vapor and a brighter icy glow between and above their heads. The cool backlight traces the fedora brim and the right shoulder while leaving their fronts in heavy shadow. Warm red fabric becomes the principal color accent, intensified by the near-monochrome steel-blue atmosphere. Fine smoky curls wind around shoulders and fade into broad soft-edged fields; the faces and hand remain more sharply defined than the background. The illustration has painterly film-poster texture, with visible blended strokes and photographic dramatic lighting rather than clean graphic lines. The close perspective and obscured setting offer almost no escape space. The whole image feels suspended at the instant before action, its small hand-to-chest gesture carrying the narrative within a broad halo of chilling mist.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感惊悚插画呈现两个人物在冷蓝烟雾中极近距离相对。左侧人物直立，戴深色软呢帽，穿红与深绿条纹毛衣。帽檐下，一张布满伤痕和深褶的脸转向对方，一只眼接住小片浅色亮光。右侧第二人穿鲜红夹克、戴软深帽，向前俯身，主要露出肩部和侧脸。一只手穿过两人之间的窄缝按在条纹胸前，使接触点成为画面中心的紧张焦点。身体占据构图大部，但左下和最右侧溶入薄雾。背后没有可辨认的房间或风景，只有分层的蓝黑水汽，以及在两人头部之间和上方更亮的冰冷光。冷背光勾出帽檐和右肩，让正面落在厚重阴影里。暖红布料成为主要彩色点缀，在近乎单色的钢蓝空气中更加强烈。细烟卷绕肩部，隐入宽阔柔边色域；面孔和手比背景清楚得多。插画有绘画式电影海报纹理，可见混合笔触与摄影般戏剧照明，而非干净图形线条。靠近的透视和被遮住的场所几乎不留逃离空间。整幅图像像悬停在行动前一瞬，手贴胸口的小动作在大片寒冷雾晕中承担叙事。
style_prompt_en: A cinematic horror-poster treatment sets a compact, sharply defined central confrontation inside broad, diffused blue-black vapor. The palette is dominated by steel blue, icy cyan, and deep navy, while intense crimson blocks provide the main chromatic pressure. A pale backlight opens an irregular halo near the upper center, catching selected outer edges and leaving frontal surfaces in heavy shadow. Soft smoke and painterly blended strokes erase the lower boundaries, but key contours and one small central contact point stay legible. Dark diagonal and vertical masses lean toward each other, reducing the negative space to a narrow lit gap. Surface texture alternates between smooth atmospheric haze and rougher, directional marks in the saturated areas. The lighting is theatrical but localized, with a cool rim and very limited warm reflection. The frame feels close, compressed, and uneasy, deriving suspense from stark red-blue opposition, hidden spatial context, and the contrast between hard focal detail and dissolving edges.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感惊悚海报处理将紧凑、清晰的中央对峙放在宽阔漫射的蓝黑水汽之中。钢蓝、冰青与深海军蓝主导配色，强烈绯红色块提供主要色彩压力。淡色背光在上方中央打开不规则光晕，抓住选定外边缘，让正面表面落入厚影。柔烟与绘画式混合笔触抹去下方边界，但关键轮廓和中央一处小接触点仍可辨。深暗对角与竖向体块互相倾斜，把负空间压成狭窄的发亮缝隙。表面纹理在平滑空气雾与饱和区域更粗、定向的笔痕之间交替。照明戏剧化却局部，只留冷轮廓光和极有限暖反射。画框紧靠、压缩而不安，悬念来自尖锐红蓝对立、隐藏的空间背景，以及坚硬焦点细节与溶解边缘之间的对照。
theme_en: Two ominous figures confronting one another in a smoky blue horror scene
theme_zh: 两名不祥人物在蓝色烟雾中的惊悚对峙
name: Wes Craven
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
